entities.summary: The University of Kitakyushu  is a public university in Kitakyushu, Japan. The main campus is located next to Keibajomae station on the Kitakyushu monorail. The second campus is in the academic zone of Wakamatsu-ku, Kitakyushu called Gakujutsu Kenkyu Toshi. The university was founded as a language academy in 1946 to help communication with the nearby American base at what is now called Yamada Ryokuchi.
